Here my code

library(ggplot2)

# calculate lower and upper band
# for y
data$y.lower<-data$y.avg-data$y.lower
data$y.upper<-data$y.avg+data$y.upper
# for x
data$x.lower<-data$x.avg-data$x.lower
data$x.upper<-data$x.avg+data$x.upper

# calculate COD i.e. coefficient of divergence
cod<-round(sqrt(mean(((data$x.avg-data$y.avg)/(data$x.avg+data
$y.avg))^2)),3)

# chart
ggplot(data, aes(x.avg, y.avg, colour=labels))+

# vertical error bar
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=y.lower, ymax=y.upper), size=0.1, width=0.1,
colour="red")+

# horizonal error bar
geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=x.lower, xmax=x.upper), size=0.1, height=0.1,
colour="red")+

# diagonal line
geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+

# leading lines to point labels
geom_segment(aes(xend = x.label, yend = y.label), linetype = "dashed")
+

# points
geom_point(aes(colour=labels), size=2.5)+
#geom_point(size=2, colour="blue")+

# label position
geom_text(aes(label=labels, x = x.label, y = y.label), colour="black",
size=2.5, hjust=0, vjust=0)+

# y axis
scale_y_log10(name="y",
limits=c(1,1000),breaks=c(1,10,100,1000),formatter="scientific")+

#ylab("y")+

# x axis
scale_x_log10(name="x", limits=c(1,1000),
breaks=c(1,10,100,1000),formatter="scientific")+

#xlab("x")+

opts(title=cod, legend.position="right", legend.title="zzz")+

# background
theme_bw(base_size = 10)

How to control the type of legend ? e.g. a gradient between two
